description:
Key Features

  • A taste of the cooling effect of mint
  • Enjoy nicotine without tobacco
  • Spit-free, mess-free, smoke-free
  • Made with pre-primed technology

Explore FRE Mint 12mg Nicotine Pouches

FRE Mint 12mg nicotine pouches deliver a tobacco-free nicotine experience with a cooling effect of mint. These pouches are made with synthetic nicotine and contain no tobacco leaf or derivatives, providing a smoke-free and spit-free option. Designed for quick nicotine release, they offer convenience and long-lasting use.

Each can contains 20 pouches, with 12mg of nicotine per pouch. These pouches can be purchased individually or in multipacks of 5, 10, 25, and 50 through Nicokick. The Mint is also available in 6mg, 9mg and 15mg nicotine strengths.

FRE Overview

FRE produces nicotine pouches using pre-primed technology for a consistent experience. The lineup includes a variety of flavors and nicotine strengths, ranging from 6mg to 15mg per pouch.
